home.heading: How can we help today?
home.intro: The assistant answers from your account data and the bank's policies. When something needs a person, it says so and hands your case over.

topics.account_inquiryBody: Balances with their as-of date, payment status, and statement summaries.
topics.card_supportBody: Card status and a protective block. Unblocks and replacements go to a person.
topics.disputeBody: Charges you do not recognize and the status of your case.
topics.creditBody: Products and an indicative eligibility result. Never an approval.

console.heading: Overview
console.agentBody: You handle structured handoffs: verified facts, actions taken, the policy basis, and open questions. Never the full transcript.

console.dashboardBody: Executive indicators, system comparisons, workflow performance, and quality slices.
console.inboxBody: Handoffs with verified facts, actions, policy, and open questions. Claim and resolve.
console.applicationsBody: Applications recorded for human review, with their assessment and originating conversation.
console.evaluationBody: Published results per workflow and in aggregate, with sample sizes and intervals.
console.tracesBody: A conversation's full record, with what the customer never sees.

demo.title: Demo guide
demo.intro: Walk through the four workflows with synthetic customers: the normal path, an ambiguous or unsupported one, and one that goes to a person, in Spanish and Portuguese.

start.title: How to start
start.step1: On sign-in, pick the scenario's demo profile. The one-time code appears on screen.
start.step2: Type the messages in the language you want to try: the assistant answers in Spanish or Portuguese.
start.step3: Actions that change something (a block, a dispute, an application) ask for confirmation and a new code.
start.step4: The execution record beside the chat shows each turn's rules, sources, and checks.
start.step5: The Talk to a person button works at any moment, in any workflow.

about.title: What this assistant does
about.intro: A customer service assistant for four topics. The language model understands your message; the bank's rules decide; and we only report actions we checked against the records.

account_inquiry.does1: Tells you your balances, with the date and time of the data cut.
account_inquiry.does2: Checks the status of your payments and transfers.
account_inquiry.does3: Summarizes a period's transactions, with totals per currency.
account_inquiry.not1: Does not make transfers or payments.
account_inquiry.not2: Does not issue official statements or certificates.

card_support.does1: Tells you the status and expiry of your cards.
card_support.does2: Blocks a card as a precaution, with your confirmation and a new code.
card_support.does3: Hands unblock and replacement requests to a person.

dispute.does1: Records a dispute for a charge you do not recognize, with your confirmation.
dispute.does2: Tells you your case status and its deadline.
dispute.does3: Offers to block the card if you do not recognize a purchase.
dispute.not2: Does not decide the dispute's outcome.

credit.does1: Describes the products of a synthetic catalog, with indicative ranges.
credit.does2: Gives an indicative eligibility result, with its reasons, its uncertainty, and a review path.
credit.does3: Records an application for a person to review.
credit.not1: Does not grant or refuse credit: no credit decisions happen in this conversation.
credit.not2: Does not use or show your score or a probability.

about.credit: Eligibility comes from a synthetic service with demonstration rules. It is an indication, never an offer or a decision. A risk estimate is only one of its inputs, and the language model never receives it.
about.data: The customers, accounts, and transactions are synthetic data from the hackathon organizer, not real people. The credit catalog and the eligibility rules are synthetic too.
about.transparency: Beside the chat you see each turn's record: what the system understood, which rules and clauses it applied, and what it checked. Model reasoning is neither stored nor shown, by design.
about.humanTitle: You can always talk to a person
about.human: When you ask, when something needs human judgment, or when a rule requires it, your case goes to a person with what we already checked, so you do not have to repeat it.
